canonical_project: Anant Raj Cloud - Panchkula data centre (DC-2)
notes: TOI (25 Jul 2025): Anant Raj launched its second Panchkula data centre adding 7 MW IT load, bringing operational capacity with Manesar (21 MW) to 28 MW. Official company news page says Panchkula site capable of supporting a 50 MW data centre (future potential). Tier III/IV infrastructure.
